$comment: Realisation for es (docs/rules/es.md; docs/rules-design.md, stage 6): es's own rules and lexicon (lexicons/es/language.yaml, lexemes.yaml), one vector per branch of every rule: a token of the course that takes it, with `spellings: false` (forms that pin spellings only passed over, as the compiler's check of the tokens does), its form spelled as the course writes it (the note); or, where no token takes the branch, a course lexeme in a paradigm cell, its spelling written by hand (said in its note). The engine's own vectors for what es needed are in realise-es-engine.json.
